title: ノゾミ（アルケミスト）第4話

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: It was the last night the members of Alces Atelier would be absent. Having finished cleaning up, {0} called out to Nozomi as both prepared to go home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アルケス錬金堂の留守を預かる最後の夜。
片付けを終えた{0}は、
帰宅の準備を整えノゾミに声をかけた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Good work, {0}-kun. Thanks for cleaning up the shop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、
お疲れさま。
お店の片付けありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Once again, thank you for helping me look after the Alces Alchemist Hall shop while those girls were away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
改めて、
アルケス錬金堂の留守を
一緒に預かってくれてありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I was just about to start my final alchemy recipe for this small adventure of ours. I wanted to give you my thanks for watching over the shop with me. This might take a while, however...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今から、
最後の錬金をしようと思ってて。
一緒に留守番してくれたお礼を、
キミに渡したくて。
ちょっと時間がかかりそうなんだけど──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: D-DID IS MIX SOMETHING IN THE WRONG WAY AGAIN OR SOMETHING?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私また調合間違っちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃああ～～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ding dong.
text_block_list.orig_text: ピンポーン。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hello~♪ Phew. It took me a while to get here while being careful not to get caught... Sorry I'm late.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは～♪
ふう。
バレないように警戒しながら来たら
時間かかっちゃった……
遅れてごめんね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: It would be a problem if a weekly magazine or online news article wrote something like "Sakurai Nozomi's love affair has been revealed! She went on a secret date at home with her boyfriend!".
text_block_list.orig_text:
週刊誌とかネットニュースで
『桜井望熱愛発覚！　
彼氏とお忍びお家デート！！』
……なんて
あることないこと書かれたら困っちゃうしね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Does that mean you'd be happy to hear such rumours about the two of us...? ...If you'd be happy about it, then I too... N-No wait, I can't!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……？
それって
私と噂になるのがうれしいってこと……？
……そういう意味なら
私も
うれ……
い、
いやダメだよっ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, that'd be a problem... If it really did become a topic of conversation, I'd never be able to come here like this again. But... I'm a little shocked.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん
困るよね……
もし本当に話題になっちゃったら、
二度とこんなふうに来たりは
できないもん。
だけど……
ちょっとショックだな。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I came here today for an important purpose. Do you remember why, {0}-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
今日は大事な目的があって来たんだから。
{0}くんは、
ちゃんと覚えてる？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. So you do remember! Here, I bought so many ingredients!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
さすがに覚えてるよね。
こんなにたくさん、
食材買ってきちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you forget? I bought so many ingredients, you know? Even if you forgot, remember!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～
忘れちゃったの？
こんなにたくさん、食材買ってきちゃったんだよ？
忘れてても思い出してよ～！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: As I said, next month, I've been invited as a guest on a cooking show that's been the talk of the town. Then plan is for me to make some curry during the show, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は来月、
最近話題の料理番組のゲストに呼ばれちゃったの。
そこで
カレーを作ることになったんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...The idea for the offer came from a certain magazine article. It was an interview from when I first started being an idol. Well, let me read a little so you understand...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……オファーのきっかけはこの雑誌の記事。
私がアイドルを始めたばかりの時のインタビュー
えっと、
ちょっと読んでみるね……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Teeheehee. Non-tan's hobby is cooking ♪ In particular, the curry I make tastes just as good as the one you get at a restaurant ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
「テヘへ、
ノンたんの趣味は料理作りなのら♪
特にカレーはお店の味にも負けない味なのら♪」

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: N-No! I didn't come up with such an answer...! I-It's not as if I was lost with what character to play as while being an idol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違うよ！
こんなの私答えてないから……！
アイドルとしてキャラに迷走してた訳じゃないから！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: This was written by my producer from back then. "Non-tan", "Namora"... And also... ...the fact that cooking is my hobby, those are all said at random.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ……
当時のプロデューサーが勝手に書いたやつでさ。
ノンたんも、
なのらも……
それに。
……趣味が料理作りっていうのも、
全部適当なの。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: It was a really small article and even I had forgotten about it by now... but it seems the staff behind the cooking show remembered it instead. And so, that's why they sent me such an offer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すっごく小さい記事だったし
私自身も忘れてたんだけど……
料理番組のスタッフさんが
この記事覚えてたみたいで。
それで
今回オファーをしてくれたんだよね……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: But I'm not good at cooking... Actually, I'd go so far as to say I'm terrible at it... so, I think I'll end up embarassing myself if I carry on like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも私、
料理なんて得意じゃないし……
っていうか
どちらかというと苦手だし……
だ、
だから、
このままじゃ恥かいちゃうと思うんだ……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: And so, that's why I want you to taste the curry I make.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
あなたに味見してほしいんだよね。
私の作ったカレーの味を。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Um, even if it's not tasty, you can honestly tell me what you think, okay? Proper practice comes from understanding my mistakes. Okay... then let's get started right away...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの、
美味しくなくても、
正直に感想言っていいからね？
それが分かれば、
ちゃんと練習できるんだし。
よし……
じゃあ
早速はじめよう……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Curry cooking... Start!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カレー作り、
スタート！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus Nozomi began cooking. With her hands feeling awkward, she put the cut ingredients into the pot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして調理を開始した望。
ぎこちない手つきで切り分けた材料をお鍋に入れた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...*Spin, spin* *Spin, spin*... Ugh... I wonder if this is going to turn out fine...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……くるくる……
くるくる……
うう……
大丈夫かな……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! You just laughed at me, didn't you, {0}-kun? Ugh~ You must think I'm so clumsy or something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ、
{0}くん今笑ったでしょ？
うう～
どうせ手際悪いですよ～
だ……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: An alchemist, you say? Yeah, I suppose I do look the part.
text_block_list.orig_text:
錬金術師？　
ああ、
たしかにそれっぽいかも。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: As the girl stirred the large, boiling cauldron she went: "Ehehehe..." ...Something like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
煮立った大きな釜をかき混ぜながら、
イッヒッヒッ……
って感じ？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, the TV. There's a new commercial I recorded that starts broadcasting today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
テレビ。
このCM
今日から放送開始なんだ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi in the TV
text_block_list.text: Nozomi Sakurai’s hairstyle is perfect, her style is perfect, and... even her scent is perfect♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
『桜井望は、
髪型も完璧♪　
おしゃれも完璧♪
そして……
香りも完璧♪』

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A new fragrance that's like an alluring accessory that tickles the tip of your nose...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『鼻先をくすぐる
アクセサリー
魅惑のフレグランス
新発売──』

text_block_list.name: Nozomi in the TV
text_block_list.text: A scent that you might... fall in love with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『香りから恋、
しちゃうかも』

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it came out well. ...Hm? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
仕上がりいい感じ。
……ん？　
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh? You find it weird to have the idol who's on your TV right now also be in your house? Ahaha, I suppose that makes sense~ It's an amazing experience, so make sure to savor it♪ ...Hehe, just kidding
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
テレビに出てるアイドルが
自分の家にいるのが変？
あはは、
そうだよ～？
すごい体験なんだから噛みしめてね♪　
えへへ、
なんちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Actually, the amazing experience is true for me aswell, I've always wanted to do something like this~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ていうか
私にとってもすごい体験なんだけど。
こういうのずっと憧れてたんだ～

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well... I was just thinking between myself how we might look like newlyweds right now. Hehe, it's nothing♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
それは……
ちょっと新婚さんみたいだな
って。
ふふ、
何でもない♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, isn't my curry pretty much done...? I'll give it a taste test.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っと、
そろそろできたかな……？
ちょっと味見してみるね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh? I wonder why...? It doesn't seem to taste good at all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
なんでだろ……？
なんか
あんまり、
美味しくない……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: There's something strange about this recipe. However it's the same exact curry my mom makes for me which I love, so why...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいな、
このレシピ。
いつもお母さんが作ってくれる
大好きなカレーと同じなのに……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ... No. I don't think that's the case. I think it's simply because I'm not good at cooking...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ううん。
多分違うと思う。
私が単純に、
料理が上手くないからだと思う……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Actually, before even worrying about the taste... The way I've cut and fried those ingredients that are now on the plate... No matter how you look at it, they don't really proclaim "Yes, my hobby is cooking♪"
text_block_list.orig_text:
っていうか、
味がどうこう以前に……
材料を切ったり、
食材を炒める手つきが、
どう見ても
「趣味は料理作りなのら♪」
じゃないよね……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... There's no way I'd be able to fool anyone with such poor practice behind me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
こんな付け焼刃の練習なんかで
ごまかせるわけないよね……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: It's over, everyone will know that I'm bad at cooking...
text_block_list.orig_text:
料理が下手なこと、
みんなに知られちゃうな……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh...? B-But! I can't let anyone see such a bad side of mine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
でも。
ダメなところは見せられないよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Even if the real me has sides that aren't good. I have to be perfect on TV, right...? ...Because I'm a perfect idol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
例え、
本物の私がダメダメだとしても。
テレビに映る私は完璧じゃなきゃダメでしょ……？
……だって
私はアイドルだから。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...It's not...? What do you mean by that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……違う……？
それってどういうこと……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "It’s true that you're not used to cooking, and the resulting craft is lacking, but the way you work so hard regardless of that is charming in its own way..." I see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに作り慣れてないから手際は良くないけど、
一生懸命作ってる姿は魅力的……
なるほど。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Seeing such unsteady hands while you cook, made me want to help you..."? Really? But that's just because I'm bad at cooking. ...Even so?
text_block_list.orig_text:
危なっかしい手つきに、
思わず手伝ってあげたくなる……？　
ほんとに？
だけど、
ただ料理が上手くないだけだよ、
私。
それでも？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Your complexes are also your charm points..."? I wonder if what you're saying now is really true...
text_block_list.orig_text:
コンプレックスも、
私のチャームポイント……？
そうなのかな、
ほんとに……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe you're right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……確かに、
キミの言う通りかもしれない。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it, the idol I admired in the past was indeed an "idol"... but at the same time she wasn't that good at singing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば
私が昔憧れたアイドルはね、
アイドルだけど、
歌がそんなに上手くなかったの。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: But even if that was used as a joke by the people around her, she'd still laugh with them. That part of her was charming, and conversely, the gap in her coolness in dancing was amazing. ...Before I knew it, she was already called a national idol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
それを周りからネタにされても、
本人は一緒に笑ってて。
そんなところが魅力的で、
逆にダンスのかっこよさのギャップが凄くて。
……いつしかその人は、
国民的アイドルって呼ばれてた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: If I can use things like my complexes as a weapon, then I'll become the strongest for sure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コンプレックスも武器にできちゃったら、
それはもう最強だね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……よし。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Thank you, {0}-kun. Thanks to you, I was able to overcome this issue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、ありがとう。
キミのおかげで吹っ切れたよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I am me, including my uncool parts. I'll expose my everything without hiding anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かっこ悪いところも含めて私だから。
全部隠さずにさらけ出してみるね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
うんっ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ughhh...
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐうう～……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ahaha. It seems my relief has come in together with my hunger. I know this curry is kind of a failure, but let's eat it together♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
あはは。
なんか安心したらお腹空いてきちゃった。
失敗カレーだけど、
一緒に食べよ♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for your hard work. How was your dream this time~...? As if I'd have to ask, it was the very best, am I right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。
今回の夢はどうだった～……
なんて。
聞くまでもなく最高だったでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: It's such a rare dream to have such a popular idol cook just for you at your own home... Do you know why you were able to have such a dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイドルが自宅で料理を作ってくれるだなんて、
激レア中の激レアな夢……
そんな夢をなんで見ることができたか分かる？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: You see... that was because of the power of a potion. ..."A potion that will let you have the best dreams" by using alchemy, I made that just for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはね。
薬の力よ。
……『最高の夢を見られる薬』
あたしが錬金術を使って作ってあげたの。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: No, it's a lie.
text_block_list.orig_text: 嘘よ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, you really are "pure" down to the core, aren't you? I bet you're taking some "pure" potion or something to keep that up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく
あんたってば本当にピュアよね。
『ピュアになる薬』でも飲んでるんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's almost time for you to get up. Well then, bye bye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
もうそろそろ起きる時間ね。
じゃ、
ばいば～い。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh... Did I fall asleep for a bit? Hm... You too, {0}-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
少し眠っちゃったのかな？
ん……
{0}くんも？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Maybe we were a little tired from all we did. That's right, let's drink some "Party Animal Elixir" together and cheer ourselves up♪ ...Ahaha, I'm just kidding♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしたら
ちょっと疲れてるのかもね。
そうだ
一緒に『いつでもパリピ薬』飲んで気分上げよっか♪
……あはは、
冗談だよ♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Oh, I still have to give you my gift. It'll be done very soon, so could you wait a little longer?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと、
キミへの贈り物。
もう少しで調合できるから
少し待ってくれる？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to get this done♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
はじめよう♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's finished♪ ...You know what this is just by looking, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
完成♪
……これなんだか分かるよね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: That's right. It's the perfume I made. Alces No. 5.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう。
私の作った香水。
『アルケスNo.５』だよ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I thought this was the perfect gift for you. ...It's a testament of our shared experiences in here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり
キミへの贈り物はこれかな
って。
……ここでの私たちの証だもんね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: My favorite scent. Would you accept it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の大好きな香り。
受け取ってくれるかな？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I should be the one thanking you. Thank you, {0}-kun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お礼を言うのは私の方だよ。
{0}くん、ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: So you want to try it on immediatly? Sure, of course, go ahead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
早速つけてみる？
うん、
もちろんいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Shhh.
text_block_list.orig_text: シュッ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Th-The scent of my beloved {0}-kun mixed with the scent of Alces No. 5, which I have personally perfected as the greatest fragrance in history...
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
元々大好きな{0}くんの香りと、
自分史上最高の香りとして完成した
『アルケスNo.５』の香りが混ざり合って……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hafuu... This is blissful...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はふぅ……
さい
っこう……♪

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?! D-Don't look...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はっ！？
み、
見ないで……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, as if. I guess it's a little late for that. You've seen me like this plenty of times before. ...My embarrassing appearance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フフ、
なーんて
今更だね。
キミにはこれまでもたくさん見られちゃってるんだもん。
……私の恥ずかしい姿。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Huh...? ...That's not what you saw?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……？
……僕が見たのは？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry, but don't look...! This is probably the most embarrassing face I've ever made...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめん
見ないで……っ！
多分今までで一番
恥ずかしい顔しちゃってるから……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I can't believe how red my face is right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
信じられないくらい真っ赤な顔、
しちゃってるから……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hey, {0}-kun... can we just be alone together for a little while longer...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ
{0}くん……
もう少しだけ、
二人っきりでいても
いいかな……？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, the final night of the two's "stay-at-home" life drew to a close...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして二人のお留守番生活、
最後の夜は更けていった──
